description:
Welcome to Stefan 3D AI👋

I’m Stefan Vaskevich — here I explore how AI is changing 3D, and test real workflows, tools, and ideas in practice.

I’ve got 10+ years of commercial experience in 3D and software, and I’ve founded a few agencies along the way — but this channel is where I break things down. Expect real pipelines, honest tests, and practical guides — from generating assets to building production-ready setups.

If you're into AI + 3D and want to stay ahead of where this is going, you're in the right place.

Subscribe and let’s explore it together 🚀
